cause: OrthoFinder returned zero after its own open-file preflight failed and emitted no mandatory final output. The recovery controller correctly rejected that zero exit.
verified_remedy: A disposable user service with LimitNOFILE=4096:4096 reported resource.getrlimit(RLIMIT_NOFILE) as (4096, 4096). A fresh v2 output will use that per-service setting; no host-wide limit is changed.
scope: This is an execution-environment correction. It does not validate reconciliation, HOGs, duplications, orthology or any biological conclusion.
